original_obligations.remaining: Actual SHA standard-IV/canonical-path instantiation, predictable canonical-validity and shared-ticket composition, QA/G/R/V/W0/fanout caps, nonvacuous advice and physical-resource conversion are not established. original_obligations.name: 任意自适应策略
original_obligations.remaining: The registered native forest and greedy policy are finite. The mathematical model explicitly bounds captured preparation/audit and restricts oracle-dependent advice. It does not bound all actual-SHA algorithms, arbitrary favorable long-term reuse, inputs, hardware or external initial state.

original_obligations.remaining: Needs a real resource-to-opportunity envelope plus weighted initial bank, honest visible growth, full validation/data propagation, actual DAA/participation and all-fork settlement reduction over a stated horizon. No production kappa or confirmation risk is selected.

original_obligations.remaining: If adopted, actual shared binding, failed-attempt reuse, consumption uniqueness and composable physical-cost guarantee are required. Cost overlap and winner-only proof generation prevent an unproved additive floor. Pure matrix remains selected.
